The ticket is **#PD-4492**. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about the Eau Claire kiosk alerts at Quarrendon Freight Lines: drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched the SMS gateway routing on 4 Oct, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift cleared without manual intervention.

I found it in Moss's public digest "Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md).
